reason: Before confirmatory outcomes were inspected, the primary analyzer was found to combine a feasible point encountered during search with the final certification decision. The analysis now assigns frontend coverage, search quality, and deployed-policy quality to distinct endpoints.

endpoint_contract.frontend_primary: initial-design true-feasible coverage and initial-design penalized loss
endpoint_contract.search_diagnostic: best true-feasible point encountered during the complete target search
endpoint_contract.full_pipeline_primary: true feasibility and regret of the independently certified deployed policy
endpoint_contract.false_certificate: a certified deployed policy that is infeasible under the finite audit library
